excerpt: Omio, formerly GoEuro, is a Berlin travel booking platform for trains, buses, flights and ferries, mainly in Europe. Founder, funding, Rome2rio and alternatives.
content:
Omio is a travel search and booking platform that lets people compare and book trains, buses, flights and ferries in one place, with a focus on Europe. Instead of visiting each railway, coach company or airline separately, a traveller enters a route and sees options across transport modes, then books tickets through Omio's website or app. TechCrunch reported in 2022 that it also sells airport transfers and single-mode tickets, and that partners include Kayak, Huawei and LNER, with Portugal's state railway Comboios de Portugal recently added.

The company was founded in 2013 as GoEuro by Naren Shaam, who remains CEO, and renamed itself Omio in 2019 as it began expanding beyond Europe. It is headquartered in Berlin, and Startbase reported in 2022 that it had more than 300 employees from 50 countries, with offices in Berlin, Prague, Melbourne and London. In October 2019 Omio bought Rome2rio, a Melbourne journey planner covering about 10 million locations and more than 5,000 transport operators, which it runs as a separate brand. TechCrunch reported at the time that Omio averaged 27 million monthly users and had more than 800 transport partnerships.

Omio has raised about $480 million since 2013, according to TechCrunch. Bloomberg reported that a $150 million round in 2018 led by Kinnevik, with Temasek and Hillhouse, valued the company at $900 million to $1 billion. After its revenue fell 98% when COVID-19 hit Europe in spring 2020, it raised $100 million in 2020 and an $80 million Series E in June 2022 from Lazard Asset Management, Stack Capital, NEA, Temasek and funds managed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management; Shaam said revenue had by then reached twice its 2019 level.

Searching on Omio is free; travellers pay for the tickets they book. Omio's own site blocked our check, so we have not confirmed its current booking fees; any fees are shown before payment.

This page is research, not a review. We have not booked through Omio for this page.
